# ANALYSIS: STAGE1_BACKTEST_J_DAYS_OOS_REALFILLS

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running a Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder will quantify the edge_capture on J's source-of-truth trade days, provide out-of-sample performance metrics, and measure real-fills slippage relative to BS-sim for the current engine configuration.

## Mechanism

We will invoke the autoresearch grinder to execute a Stage-1 backtest over the full available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using the current engine parameters (as of params.json). The backtest will record per-trade P&L, aggregate edge_capture on the six J anchor days (winners and losers), compute walk-forward OOS Sharpe, and compare BS-sim vs realistic OPRA fills on the top three J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to assess slippage.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** The backtest will use the full available OPRA cache (approx 16 months) with no look-ahead bias; sample size is all trades triggered by the current engine; overfit risk is mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will be computed as part of Stage-1 backtest walk-forward).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will compare BS-sim vs realistic OPRA simulator on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loser if the engine takes a losing J day; max drawdown depends on equity curve; blow-up scenario if risk rules are violated (e.g., exceeding 50% per-trade risk).
6. **Concentration:** Will be measured post-backtest; currently unknown.

## Pre-merge gate

The backtest must pass: gym validators (all tests pass), walk-forward OOS Sharpe >= 0.70, real-fills slippage < ±20% on top 3 J days, and edge_capture >= 771 (OP-16 floor).
